name: numencode/wn-fundamentals-plugin
description: Toolbox for Winter CMS projects: inline relation repeaters, publishable models, theme-overridable component layouts, backend improvements, Twig functions and PHP helpers.

suggest.winter/wn-pages-plugin: Enables the static page settings in the main tabs and, with Winter.Translate, clearing its caches of all locales.
suggest.winter/wn-translate-plugin: Enables translations of fields inside relation repeaters, the language selector in backend forms and clearing the Winter.Pages caches of all locales.
